title: Crispy Swiss Potato & Leek Rösti
ingredients: 2 lbs Russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled
2 medium leeks (white and light green parts), halved and thinly sliced
2 tbsp unsalted butter + 2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup grated Gruyère or Parmesan cheese (optional)
1 tsp kosher salt & 1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper
Fresh chives or thyme for garnish
instructions: Sauté the thinly sliced leeks in 1 tbsp butter over medium heat for 6–8 minutes until sweet and softened.
Coarsely grate the peeled potatoes on a box grater, then wring out as much liquid as possible using a clean kitchen towel.
Toss the dry shredded potatoes in a bowl with the sautéed leeks, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and optional Gruyère.
Heat 1 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick or cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Pack the potato-leek mixture into an even cake, pressing firmly with a spatula.
Fry for 8–10 minutes per side (invert onto a plate to flip) until both sides are deeply golden brown and shattering-crisp.
